description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for exporting destination data from EconDB, including query parameters, data models, and asynchronous data extraction logic.

classes.name: EconDbExportDestinationsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for EconDB export destinations, allowing multiple country items.

classes.name: EconDbExportDestinationsData
classes.description: Data model for export destinations, including units, title, and optional footnote.

classes.name: EconDbExportDestinationsFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving export destination data asynchronously from EconDB.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an EconDbExportDestinationsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and processes data from EconDB for specified countries.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data dictionaries into EconDbExportDestinationsData instances.
